note: Help-video manifest for the Ehyeh app 'Watch how' slots. Each entry maps a view id to a video file. Files live in help-videos/ next to the HTML. The HTML embeds a copy of this manifest (build step: copy verbatim into HAGAH_HELP_VIDEOS) so the page stays a single self-contained file and never needs a network fetch (the page CSP forbids it). If a listed file is missing or unloadable, the page shows a friendly placeholder message instead of a broken player.
